framework.description: Optional hint naming the test framework/tool to use (e.g. `"cargo-llvm-cov"`).

rootUri.description: Absolute path of the workspace root the server should analyse.

ClientCapabilities.description: Capabilities the client advertises to the server.

coverageGutter.description: Client can render coverage in the editor gutter.

staleness.description: Client understands `stale` flags and will visually distinguish stale data.

testResults.description: Client can display test results inline / in a panel.
